source: nilgai's false colour. Each instrument's band is written in its own units, as its paper writes it, and shown as a slice of visible light. The bands are cited; the hues are chosen, not measured, in spectral order so shorter looks bluer, clear of the dim ends of the eye. Retune the hues here.

profiles.name: fermi
profiles.band: 4FGL-DR4 catalogue range, 50 MeV to 1 TeV (the release is DR4, Ballet et al. 2023, arXiv 2307.12546; the column definitions are DR3's, Abdollahi et al. 2022, ApJS 260, 53)

profiles.name: chandra
profiles.band: Chandra Source Catalog broad band b, 0.5 to 7 keV (Evans et al. 2010, ApJS 189, 37)

profiles.name: neowise
profiles.band: WISE W1 and W2 together, about 2.8 to 5.3 um; edges approximate until read from Wright et al. 2010, AJ 140, 1868

profiles.name: meerkat
profiles.band: MeerKAT L band, 856 to 1712 MHz (Heywood et al. 2022, ApJ 925, 165)
